youtube.title: Revenge Trading: The Trap That Eats Accounts #Shorts
youtube.description:
Revenge trading is the trap that eats trading accounts: after a loss you trade bigger, faster and without a plan. The recovery maths is brutal: lose 10% and you need about 11% to get back; lose 50% and you need 100%. One fix: a maximum daily loss, decided before the market opens.

Numbers in this video:
• Recovery maths: gain needed = loss ÷ (1 − loss). 10% loss needs 11.1%; 50% loss needs 100%

Have you ever tried to win back a loss the same day? What happened? Comment below.

Lose 10% and you need 11% just to get back.
Lose 50% and you need 100%.
Bigger trades after a loss dig the hole deeper.
Set a max loss for the day. Hit it, close the app, walk away.
